findings.entity: hand-held grooming tool (real hand vs. mirror reflection)
findings.description: The slim white razor-like implement held at the jaw from 00:00-00:01.5 becomes a dark/black comb in the real hand around 00:02.25-00:04.0 (clearly dark-toothed in full-res frames 13 and 17), while the mirror reflection of the same hand at the same moment still shows a pale white/lavender flat blade; it then reverts to the pale implement at 00:04.25. No tool swap, set-down, or pickup is visible, and real object and reflection disagree in kind.

The tool, rendered for most of the clip as a matte white/pale plastic-looking implement, becomes a clearly silver metallic straight razor with a handle at 00:09.25-00:09.75 with no visible exchange of tools.
